_format: Shared golden for slot-docking geometry: Rust src-tauri/src/layout/bands.rs + drag_size.rs and the TS mirrors dock/bands.ts, dockedTree.ts, judge.ts, dragSize.ts. Generated by the ignored Rust test regenerate_bands_golden (src-tauri/src/layout/bands/golden.rs) - never edit by hand. _constants = DOCK_CONSTANTS of src-tauri/bindings/DockConstants.ts exactly. ratio_limits = the split ratio limits the rules ran with (snapshot ratio_min / ratio_max). bands[] = one window each. Inputs: canvas {w,h} (integer CSS px); canvas_origin {x,y} and tab_bar {x0,y0,x1,y1}|null in viewport CSS px (tab_bar = the tab drag area); layout = the visible tab's LayoutNode in wire shape; shape = the dragged tab's layout as carried in the drag MIME type (pre-order: l = slot, h<ratio>_ = left|right split, v<ratio>_ = top|bottom split, each split followed by its two children; give its slots fresh ids that are not in layout); original {w,h}|null = the dragged tab's original size (null = unknown: treat the length as NaN, so the share is ATTACH_SHARE_MAX). Outputs: zone = zone_in_canvas(strip_zone(tab_bar), canvas_origin) in canvas px, or null. blocked = every {anchor, side} whose docked tree fails (a new zero-area slot), outer sides first, then slots in pre-order, sides in SIDE_ORDER; the share for each is attach_share(original, side, target) with target = the slot frame or the whole canvas. bands = effective_bands in order: anchor ('outer' or the slot id), side, band (the whole band before subtraction), areas (what picks), share, landing (the preview = where the dragged tab will be drawn). slots = frames in pre-order: id, frame, zones ({slot: band frame, centre} drawn while the cursor is over that slot; null when the slot has no valid slot band). points = [x, y, pick, zones] in canvas CSS px: pick = 'strip' inside zone (half-open), else the index into bands chosen there, else null; zones = the index into slots whose zone lines are drawn there (null on the strip, on an outer band, outside the canvas, or over a slot with no valid slot band). The rest of the guide follows from pick: the preview is the picked band's landing, and the layout frame (the whole canvas) is drawn only while the picked band is an outer band. All rects are {x0,y0,x1,y1} edges, half-open. drag_size[] = drag_sizes: inputs restored {w,h}|null (window:frame restored inner size), maximized, insets {t,r,b,l} (window:frame), viewport (inner size now), work (screen.avail*), chrome (viewport - canvas), single (a tab-one popout); outputs size {w,h}|null (new window inner size; null = move that window as it is) and original {w,h}.
